name: Straight mine track
description: A straight 1.5 m section of narrow-gauge mine track: two rusty flat-bottomed iron rails with wheel-worn heads, spiked through tie plates to five dark wooden sleepers on a little gravel, bolted with fishplates at one end. Sections join end to end.
